Name: (CP)Adorable Animal Crops
Author: LunariaFaye
Description:
Ongoing updates~
持续更新中～

Currently added: Starfruit, Tomato, Ancient Fruit, Strawberry, Qi Fruit, Hops,Blueberry,Bok Choy,Corn,Parsnip,Pumpkin,Grape,Pineapple,Sweet Gem Berry,Potato,Powdermelon,Fiber,Carrot,Cauliflower,Green Bean,Wheat,Garlic,Summer Squash,Melon,Kale,Rhubarb,Taro Root,Radish,Cranberries,Beet。

目前已添加杨桃、番茄、上古水果、草莓、齐瓜、啤酒花、蓝莓、小白菜、玉米、防风草、南瓜、葡萄、菠萝、宝石甜莓、土豆、霜瓜、纤维、胡萝卜、花椰菜、青豆、小麦、蒜、金皮西葫芦、甜瓜、甘蓝、大黄、芋头、萝卜、蔓越莓、甜菜。


You can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to individually disable the texture of any crop or item.
你可以使用mod配置菜单单独禁用某个作物或物品的纹理


I have installed ReShade. If you want to achieve the effect shown in my screenshot, you will need to install
我安装了ReShade，如果您想要达到我展示图的效果，您需要安装

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - ReShade[/url]

Compatible with 1.6 and 1.5
兼容1.6与1.5

Extract the files and place them in the mods folder.
将文件解压后放入mod文件夹即可


Modification allowed for personal use only.
二次修改仅允许个人使用。

Uploading to other websites is prohibited.
禁止上传到其他网站。
